related.title: NSTX-U 球形電漿研究
related.transfer: 可遷移「磁壓與比壓」與「密度極限」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；NSTX-U 球形電漿研究的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Magnetic pressure and beta" and "The density limit" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of NSTX-U spherical-plasma research must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦美國最大托卡馬克的定量檢核：形狀控制、邊界局域模抑制與破裂的電流衰減；NSTX-U 球形電漿研究則以球形電漿研究裝置的定量檢核：中心柱每匝電流、銅線圈的脈衝長度、暈電流受力為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on quantitative checks of the largest US tokamak: shape control, suppression of edge-localised modes and current quench in disruptions; NSTX-U spherical-plasma research centres on quantitative checks of a spherical-plasma research device: current per turn in the centre stack, pulse length of copper coils and halo-current forces, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」與「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「電子迴旋共振與加熱頻率」的模型移到NSTX-U 球形電漿研究，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「密度極限」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Device size and plasma volume" and "Device size and plasma volume".
Move the model of "Electron cyclotron resonance and heating frequency" to NSTX-U spherical-plasma research, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The density limit", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「磁壓與比壓」與「密度極限」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；NSTX-U 球形電漿研究的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Magnetic pressure and beta" and "The density limit" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of NSTX-U spherical-plasma research must be respecified.

related.title: ITER 國際磁約束研究工程
related.transfer: 可遷移「磁壓與比壓」與「密度極限」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Magnetic pressure and beta" and "The density limit" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦美國最大托卡馬克的定量檢核：形狀控制、邊界局域模抑制與破裂的電流衰減；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程則以國際熱核融合實驗堆的定量檢核：真空室扇段、七方實物貢獻、分階段運轉與破裂緩解為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on quantitative checks of the largest US tokamak: shape control, suppression of edge-localised modes and current quench in disruptions; ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering centres on quantitative checks of ITER: vacuum-vessel sectors, in-kind contributions of seven members, staged operation and disruption mitigation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」與「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「電子迴旋共振與加熱頻率」的模型移到ITER 國際磁約束研究工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「三乘積與點火條件」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Device size and plasma volume" and "Device size and plasma volume".
Move the model of "Electron cyclotron resonance and heating frequency" to ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Triple product and the ignition condition", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「磁壓與比壓」與「密度極限」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Magnetic pressure and beta" and "The density limit" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: DIII-D 可重組 tokamak 研究
history.text: DIII-D 可重組 tokamak 研究的公開資料展示磁形、診斷與核心邊緣整合的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for DIII-D configurable tokamak research illustrate magnetic shaping, diagnostics and core-edge integration. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型

history.text: 本課將磁形、診斷與核心邊緣整合改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns magnetic shaping, diagnostics and core-edge integration into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
